renderer: Complete export: Rust procedural baseline, Sharp SVG overrides, then preserved Archive ICO extraction

authoritative_source.procedural: renderer/src/suite.rs (Command, Ghost, Vault, PDF, Spaces, Mail, Outlook)
authoritative_source.outline: svg/horizon.svg, svg/crystalwire.svg; optical sizing and export in svg/render.cjs
authoritative_source.archive: raster/archive.ico; native frame extraction and derived PNGs in raster/render.cjs

profile: release; opt-level=3; no custom target-cpu or fast-math flags

pdf_document_icons: Preserved legacy ICOs; not generated by this renderer
